essence: The teaching that follows is attributed to the sage Vatsyayana.
The rite requires uniting this substance and placing it on the forehead.
Successful subjugation yields long-lasting earthly enjoyment for the practitioner.
The practitioner's own five-limb impurity can be used as an equivalent substance.
The method is asserted to grant power to subjugate the whole world without doubt.
